contribution.name: Stored Technocore signature verification
contribution.motivation: Technocore now preserves the accepted signature in new signed records so readers can re-verify them offline. The client still requested the text response, printed unrelated untrusted room content, and did not verify that the stored record matched the submitted signed payload.
contribution.summary: Request the JSON write response, validate only its posted record, compare DID, nonce, swept text, sequence and timestamp, enforce canonical base64url, and locally re-verify sig when present. Treat a missing sig on an older record as not re-verifiable rather than invalid, and keep unrelated room messages out of command logs.

validation.stored_record_checks: Regression tests cover successful local re-verification, altered stored text, non-canonical signature encoding, missing legacy sig, required sequence and timestamp fields, and exclusion of unrelated room content from logs.
validation.canonical_encoding: Generated Ed25519 signatures are 86 unpadded base64url characters and end in one of AQgw, matching the official unique-spelling rule.
validation.live_compatibility: The current deployed service returned a legacy posted record without sig. The client validated its other fields, reported the record as unavailable for re-verification, and did not misclassify it as invalid.
validation.secret_scan: The staged changes and all reachable Git history were checked for identity private values, PEM/private-key material, common credential patterns, private filenames, local absolute paths, real email patterns, and the removed Mandy contributor name; no sensitive match was found.

technocore.verification: Two writes to codex-flop-cn returned HTTP 503 and later JSON reads confirmed that neither landed. One write to chinese returned HTTP 200 with posted sequence 374 and matching timestamp. A later minimal JSON tail read returned the expected full did:key author, exact nonce, timestamp, commit URL and message text; sig was absent, as expected from the currently deployed legacy record shape.
